workflows.title: Sales prospect research and outreach drafting
workflows.ask: Set up an agent that researches new CRM leads, drafts personalised outreach emails, and queues them for my reps to approve before sending.

steps.label: Ingest lead event from CRM
Dedupe lead against CRM
PII scan and mask sensitive data
Enrich firmographics via API
Research company site and news in parallel
Retrieve matching case studies from answer library
Score ICP fit with structured output
Evaluate research quality against rubric
Draft first-touch email and follow-ups
Compliance screen for claims and PII leakage
Seller reviews and approves draft in CRM queue
Send approved email via ESP
Write activity and research summary to CRM
Done

human_gates: Seller must approve drafted email before send because it is an external send with legal and reputational effect.

loops.what: Re-research if evaluation score is below threshold

workflows.volume: 10,000 runs per month (based on report cost model for mid-size SDR team)
traps: Do not use AgentBay (closed to new customers); use agent-sandbox instead.
Do not use Model Studio knowledge base or zero-code workflow apps (blocked for accounts created after 2025-04-21); use DashVector or Tablestore Knowledge Storage.
Do not use AI Search Open Platform (not available in Singapore).
Web search tool costs $10 per 1,000 calls in Singapore; estimator must include this fee.
PrivateLink is not available in Singapore.

workflows.title: RFP and security questionnaire answering
workflows.ask: Build an agent that parses incoming RFPs, drafts answers from our approved policy library, checks them for hallucinations, and routes them to SMEs for sign-off.

steps.label: Receive RFP document upload
Parse document and extract atomic questions
Classify questions by risk and answerability
Retrieve approved answers and evidence chunks
Draft answers with inline citations
Faithfulness check against retrieved evidence
Freshness and conflict check on cited policies
Route by confidence: auto-approve, SME, or legal
SME or legal edits and approves answers
Assemble response document in required format
Final compliance screen for over-claiming
Submit to bid desk and update answer library
Done

human_gates: SME or legal must approve drafted answers before submission because RFP responses carry binding legal and financial commitments.
workflows.volume: 50 runs per month (based on enterprise average of 20-30 hours per RFP)
workflows.outcome: 50% time savings to bid team members, 40% to SMEs; source: https://www.nfold.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/Forrester-Loopio-report-2023.pdf
traps: qwen-long does not support function calling or built-in tools; use standard chat models for extraction steps requiring tools.
Batch inference in Singapore does not support qwen3.8-max or qwen3.8-flash; check per-model batch eligibility.
Do not use Model Studio knowledge base for new accounts; use Tablestore Knowledge Storage or DashVector.
AgentRun low-code Flow Agent creation is in maintenance mode; use code-first runtime only.

workflows.title: Meeting notes to CRM updates
workflows.ask: Create a workflow that transcribes our sales calls, extracts deal updates, and shows the rep a diff to approve before writing anything to Salesforce.

steps.label: Call recording completed webhook
Transcribe audio and diarise speakers
Mask PII in transcript before storage
Summarise decisions, objections, and next steps
Extract structured CRM field deltas via JSON Schema
Retrieve prior meeting history for this opportunity
Conflict check against current CRM state
Score deal risk signals
Seller confirms each field change in a diff view
Write approved fields and tasks to CRM
Draft follow-up email to attendees
Seller approves follow-up email
Send follow-up email
Done

human_gates: Seller must approve CRM field changes because they are irreversible writes affecting revenue forecasting.
Seller must approve follow-up email because it is an external send to customers.
workflows.volume: 200 runs per day (based on 20 sellers doing ~10 meetings/day)
traps: Singapore streaming ASR (qwen-audio-3.1-asr-flash) costs $0.93 input / $0.70 output per 1M tokens, not the cheaper Beijing prices quoted in some older docs.
qwen3-vl-plus has no function calling or batch in Singapore.
Do not use AgentBay; use agent-sandbox if sandboxed execution is needed.
AgentCore IM channels are DingTalk/Lark/WeCom only; do not draw Slack or Teams as native AgentCore channels (use webhooks to FC instead).

workflows.title: Marketing content generation and localisation
workflows.ask: Set up an agent that takes our English campaign brief, generates master copy, translates it into five APAC languages, and queues it for in-market review before publishing.

steps.label: Campaign brief submitted via chat
Classify asset type, channel, audience, and risk tier
Retrieve brand voice and banned claims guidelines
Generate master copy variants in source language
Brand and claims substantiation screen
Brand/legal gate approval on master copy
Translate master copy to target locales in parallel
Transcreation pass for idioms and cultural nuance
Locale-specific compliance and cultural screen
In-market reviewer approves per locale
Publish approved assets to CMS and ad platforms
Done

human_gates: Master copy requires brand/legal approval because downstream localisation spend is wasted if the source is wrong or non-compliant.
Per-locale in-market approval is required before publishing due to legal effect of advertising claims in different jurisdictions.

loops.what: Regenerate underperformers based on CTR/CVR feedback
loops.exit: stop condition: CTR exceeds baseline threshold

workflows.volume: 500 runs per month (based on mid-size retail content calendar)
traps: Use qwen-mt-plus or qwen-mt-lite for translation; qwen-mt-uni is China-site only (Beijing) and must be excluded.
Qwen-MT-Image is China-site only; international alternative is Qwen-VL read plus Qwen-Image-Edit rewrite.
Do not use Model Studio knowledge base for new accounts; use DashVector or Tablestore Knowledge Storage.
Korea's AI Basic Act Art. 31 requires labelling generative AI outputs; ensure human gate covers this for KR locales.

workflows.title: Social listening and review analysis
workflows.ask: Build an agent that ingests marketplace reviews, clusters them by theme, drafts replies for negative ones, and holds them for PR approval before posting.

steps.label: Scheduled poll for new reviews and mentions
Ingest raw mentions and store metadata
Language ID and drop spam/bots/duplicates
Sentiment, emotion, and intent classification
Extract product entities and aspect-level sentiment
OCR text inside attached screenshots or receipts
Cluster themes using embeddings and taxonomy
Detect volume spikes or sentiment anomalies
Draft public reply in reviewer language if warranted
PR team approves public reply before posting
Post approved reply or route defect ticket to product
Done

human_gates: PR team must approve any public reply before posting because it is an external send with brand and legal risk, especially during crisis keywords.

loops.what: Re-score conversation sentiment after reply to measure movement

workflows.volume: 50,000 runs per day (based on mid-size retailer monitoring multiple marketplaces and social channels)
workflows.outcome: 75% of Instagram DMs resolved in under a minute; source: https://www.sprinklr.com/stories/
traps: Separate ingest from act to prevent prompt injection from untrusted public content executing outbound tools (lethal trifecta).
Do not use AgentBay; use agent-sandbox if browser automation is needed for scraping.
Content moderation text V2.0 in Singapore is $0.30 per 1,000 tasks.
Chat App Message Service charges a platform fee of $0.005 per message for Messenger, Instagram, Telegram, and LINE since 2026-09-01.

workflows.title: E-commerce product listing creation from images
workflows.ask: Set up a pipeline that takes supplier photos, extracts attributes, generates SEO-friendly listings in multiple languages, and queues them for merchandiser approval before pushing to Amazon and Shopee.

steps.label: Supplier image drop into OSS bucket
Normalise images and strip EXIF/PII
Read text in packaging and labels
Identify category, material, colour, and defects from images
Retrieve target marketplace taxonomy and required attributes
Map extracted attributes to taxonomy; abstain if low confidence
Generate title, bullets, description, and SEO keywords
Localise listing copy for each marketplace locale
Compliance screen for restricted claims and prohibited words
Merchandiser reviews diff and bulk-approves listings
Publish approved listings to PIM and marketplaces via API
Done

human_gates: Merchandiser must approve listings before publishing because incorrect attributes (material, voltage, allergens) cause returns, safety events, and legal liability.

loops.what: Regenerate copy if listing quality score is below marketplace rubric threshold

workflows.volume: 10,000 runs per month (based on catalog enrichment sweep for mid-size e-commerce)
workflows.outcome: 40% increase in overall listing quality; source: https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/innovation-at-amazon/amazon-generative-ai-seller-growth-shopping-experience
traps: Use qwen3.5-ocr, not the deprecated qwen-vl-ocr-2024-10-28.
Batch inference in Singapore excludes qwen3.8-max and qwen3.8-flash; verify model eligibility before sizing bulk jobs.
Do not use Aidge APIs unless explicitly scoped, as Aidge is Alibaba International Digital Commerce, not Alibaba Cloud proper.
Amazon requires disclosure metadata for photorealistic AI-generated people; agent must flag generated lifestyle images.

workflows.title: Inbound support email triage and reply drafting
workflows.ask: Build an agent that catches inbound support emails, classifies the issue, pulls tracking info, drafts a reply, and waits for a supervisor to approve it before sending.

steps.label: Inbound email received via webhook
Classify intent and urgency of the email
Extract order ID, tracking number, and customer details
Fetch shipment status from logistics API
Retrieve relevant SOPs and resolution templates
Draft personalised resolution email
Check draft for PII leakage and tone compliance
Supervisor reviews and approves the draft reply
Send approved reply to customer
Log interaction and outcome to support memory
Done

human_gates: Supervisor must approve the draft reply before sending because it is an external communication that may contain refunds, exceptions, or binding service commitments.
workflows.volume: 2,000 runs per day (based on mid-size logistics provider daily support volume)
workflows.outcome: 50% of inquiries resolved autonomously when approved; source: https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/metrics/
traps: Inbound email must arrive via webhook into EventBridge or Function Compute; do not draw native email polling nodes.
DirectMail initial daily quota is 2,000 emails and depends on sender reputation; size accordingly.
Do not use Model Studio knowledge base for new accounts; use Tablestore Knowledge Storage or DashVector.
AgentRun code-first only; do not use low-code Flow Agent creation which is in maintenance mode.

workflows.title: Cross-border trade document compliance check
workflows.ask: Create a workflow where uploaded customs invoices and packing lists are parsed, checked against destination-country regulations, flagged for risks, and sent to a compliance officer for final approval before submission.

steps.label: Trade documents uploaded to portal
Parse PDFs and extract tabular invoice data
Extract HS codes, values, weights, and origin countries
Retrieve destination country regulatory rules and embargoes
Compare extracted data against regulatory requirements
Flag discrepancies, missing certificates, or restricted items
Draft compliance summary and remediation steps
Compliance officer reviews flags and approves submission
Submit approved documents to customs broker API
Done

human_gates: Compliance officer must approve before submission because customs declarations carry strict legal effects, financial penalties, and border-control implications.

loops.what: Re-extract and re-evaluate if OCR confidence is below threshold

workflows.volume: 300 runs per day (based on mid-size freight forwarder daily shipment volume)
traps: Use qwen3.5-ocr for document parsing; default output is 4,096 tokens, raise toward 8,192 via commercial manager if needed.
Do not use AgentBay; use agent-sandbox for any sandboxed code execution.
Ensure cross-border data transfer mechanisms are respected (e.g., Thailand PDPA has no adequacy-designated countries yet, Vietnam PDP Law requires impact assessments).
AI Guardrails console supports Singapore internationally; billable at $6 per 10,000 calls per enabled detection type.
